dataset: Physical data for Sun, planets and selected moons

source.nssdca_note: Physical data cites the NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics pages and NASA Horizons API listed above. The NASA/NSSDCA planetary fact sheets at https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/ do not publish obliquity to orbit for the satellites carried here.

units.axial_tilt_obliquity_to_orbit_deg: degrees (obliquity to orbit; for the Sun, obliquity to the ecliptic as printed by the source); null where the cited sources publish no value
units.colour_hex: sRGB hex, presentational only, chosen editorially, not a measured quantity

bodies.name: Sun
bodies.axial_tilt_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?format=text&COMMAND='10'&OBJ_DATA='YES'&MAKE_EPHEM='NO' (printed as 'Obliquity to ecliptic = 7.25 deg.'; the Sun has no orbit, so this is relative to the ecliptic)
bodies.rotation_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?format=text&COMMAND='10'&OBJ_DATA='YES'&MAKE_EPHEM='NO' ('Adopted sid. rot. per.= 25.38 d'; hours computed as days x 24)

bodies.name: Mercury
bodies.axial_tilt_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?format=text&COMMAND='199'&OBJ_DATA='YES'&MAKE_EPHEM='NO'. Horizons prints 'Obliquity to orbit[1] = 2.11' +/- 0.1'' in arcminutes; 2.11/60 = 0.0352 deg (computed)
bodies.rotation_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/planets/phys_par.html (Sidereal Rotation Period column, in days; hours computed as days x 24)

bodies.name: Venus
bodies.rotation_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/planets/phys_par.html (Sidereal Rotation Period column, in days; hours computed as days x 24)
bodies.rotation_note: Negative value indicates retrograde rotation, as printed by the source.

bodies.name: Moon
bodies.rotation_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?format=text&COMMAND='301'&OBJ_DATA='YES'&MAKE_EPHEM='NO' ('Sid. rot. rate, rad/s = 0.0000026617'; period computed as 2*pi/rate, converted to hours, rounded to 3 dp)
bodies.radius_note: The satellite physical parameters page prints 1737.4 (IAU value); the Horizons 301 sheet prints 'Vol. mean radius, km = 1737.53+-0.03'.

bodies.axial_tilt_source: Not published by the cited sources: the JPL Horizons satellite sheets, the JPL SSD physical parameter pages and the NSSDCA fact sheets do not print obliquity to orbit for this body; recorded as null, not invented.
bodies.rotation_source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api?format=text&COMMAND='401'&OBJ_DATA='YES'&MAKE_EPHEM='NO' ('Rotational period = Synchronous'); hours computed as the orbital period from https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/sats/elem/ x 24.

bodies.rotation_note: Negative by simulator convention: the orbit is retrograde (inclination 157.3 deg in the source elements) and rotation is synchronous.
